book.name: Masatarangana
book.title: Israelchich tputs masatarangana Israelchich apusash masaru taarangana anoo kamankiya

content: Ashiriya, na kamanchintspa yuwaatsshat Israelchich tputs tsapoo machee kasarangusin, piyamsha naatarangana anootsi
Israelchich tputs Sinaymand mach káyarandsin, tuchip zar naayintarashin ashkusin, Apanllee kajonarini yamazarsin kukutssin ashiranganaya. ¿Yapeeja taayamchich? atusin, ashiranganaya.
Uwshtisin ngootsish naa ashkusin, msassha tputsimun iwaz zaree kámanarangiya. Ichingaru zar ashirangiya.
Uru Apanllee wizpurirni kajon tinamaa yusur kuyarusin, naakchusin, anush Móysissha;
Msassha yusur karuwataraa ashirangu, kajoneetssha yusur tsapush wayaranganaya. Sheersin, Móysissha;
tárangiya. Ashiriya, na kamaneena, yuwaa Apanll yusur msasee Israelchicheem zanganirangu anootsi.
